name: Goblin Bombardier
oracle: Sacrifice a Goblin: This creature deals 2 damage to any target.

name: Twin Offering
oracle: Sacrifice two creatures: Draw two cards.

name: Any-Color Cantor
oracle: Sacrifice this creature: Add one mana of any color.

name: Bitter Bargain
oracle: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or discard a card.
should: record the 'or discard a card' alternative, not just 'or pay {N}'

name: Culling Rite
oracle: Sacrifice a creature and an artifact: Draw two cards.

name: Diplomatic Purge
oracle: Sacrifice a nonland permanent: Counter target spell.

name: Cruel Edict II
oracle: When this creature enters, each player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker.
note: another player sacrifices (edict), not the controller
should: capture WHO sacrifices (each player / target opponent), not assume the controller

name: Ritual of the Machine
oracle: Sacrifice a creature: Draw a card. Activate this ability only as a sorcery and only once each turn.
should: extract 'only as a sorcery' and 'only once each turn' (cf. pt10.md #2)

name: Grave Tithe
oracle: Sacrifice X creatures, where X is the number of opponents you have: Each opponent loses 2 life.
